If I shift the fraction to about .9, I get y=.53, which might not fully cover the goal disk.

I'm thinking about how friction can affect gait, possibly by increasing traction and turning dynamics. The change in obstacle size also impacts the positioning and geometry based on certain fractions. This could influence the route topology as well.
